title: EVALUATING CULTURAL AWARENESS OF LLMS FOR YORUBA, MALAYALAM, AND ENGLISH

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM responses to translated binary questionnaires based on Hofstede's six cultural dimensions against human ground-truth surveys from Malayalam, Yoruba, and English speakers to calculate a cultural similarity score.
Measuring the disparity in cultural understanding and alignment when models are prompted in underrepresented regional languages (Malayalam and Yoruba) versus English.
